components.title: agent-gateway
components.description: Gateway that fronts AI agent interactions and records each one as a trace. The trace log is the automatic record of the system's functioning, evaluated against the agent registry's qualified surface.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Every agent interaction is recorded as a trace and judged against the agent's registered prompts and tools.

props.name: Check_Description
props.value: fabric trace turns the gateway interaction log into evidence, confirming each interaction stayed within the agent's qualified surface in the registry.

control-implementations.description: Automatic record-keeping for AI agent interactions in the pharma MES baseline.

implemented-requirements.description: The gateway automatically records every agent interaction as a trace, giving traceability of the system's functioning over its lifetime.
